items.title: 3 ETFs For Tesla As Its Germany Expansion Changes The Mix
items.summary: You can own Tesla directly and let every twist in its story hit your portfolio on its own, or you can hold it through a fund alongside many other businesses. Direct ownership leaves you carrying company specific issues such as profit margins slipping from 5.3% to 3.1% and shareholders being diluted, both highlighted by Simply Wall St, without anything else in the mix to blunt those swings. An ETF still leaves you tied to Tesla, just with other holdings around it that also trim the upside. The...
